name: Proton Pass
author: Josh Garcia
description: Quick-access search and copy for Proton Pass logins via the official pass-cli.

barWidget.description: Search Proton Pass logins; copy username, password, or TOTP.

schema.label: Paste once
schema.description: Clipboard offers the value a single time. Some apps (Electron, browsers) read the clipboard more than once per paste and will fail.

schema.label: Excluded vaults
schema.description: Comma-separated vault names to hide from search.

schema.label: Show recent items
schema.description: Show recently copied logins before searching. Disabling deletes stored recent-item metadata.
